remarks: Completely renovated and move-in ready! This bright and spacious second-floor, ranch-style apartment features two generous bedrooms, a large living room, and a beautifully updated kitchen with tile floor, shaker-style cabinetry and all newer appliances. The fully tiled bathroom has been tastefully renovated, and every room has been freshly painted. Enjoy plenty of closet space throughout, plus additional storage in the shared basement, which also includes convenient coin-operated laundry facilities. Two reserved parking spaces are included. Fantastic location, just minutes to Cove Island Park and beaches, Chelsea Piers, local parks, and vibrant downtown Stamford shops and restaurants. A commuter's dream with easy access to I-95 and nearby public transportation. Heat and hot water are included in the rent! Tenant responsible only for electric, cooking gas, and cable/internet. Good credit and income required.
